title: 第3章 它没死第4章 未曾设想过的剧情线
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: “他跑去妖鬼王的巢穴做什么？”
宁语、坤还有红衣女一伙人狗狗祟祟顺着珲伍的路线摸黑来到辛之墓群的边缘，就不敢继续往前了。
因为再往前他们就离开了墓群的蕈类荧光的掩护，游离在这片地底世界的妖鬼子嗣会很快发现他们的踪迹。
一群人猫在墓群边缘的低洼地带，暗中观察着那个衣着古怪的亡者。
红衣女：“辛之墓群里只有死人和妖鬼，它不是亡魂肯定就是活尸，没有必要深究死人的行为逻辑。”
宁语：“我见过活尸和亡魂，那种生灵是没有自主意识和行为逻辑的，但他不一样。”
红衣女冷冷地瞪了宁语一眼。
要不是这个读死书的法师突然犯圣母病，他们这会儿已经把那亡者的尸体丢进篝火祭坛启动传送阵跑路了。
宁语不服地瞪了回去：“我没乱说，他真的是密大学院的老师，立碑时间是天监纪元二十三年，碑文上就是这么写的。”
坤：“天监纪元存不存在都不好说…”
红衣女也没好气地对宁语道：“那你再过去劝一劝，让它把自己火化了放我们离开这里。”
宁语：“去就去！”
她抱着辞典作势就要起身。
还没等魁梧男人将她拦下，红衣女就一把摁住她的肩膀把她摁了回去，压低声音骂道：“不要命了！”
一群人踌躇不前的时候。
珲伍只身进入了妖鬼王的巢穴。
坤：“它就这么走进去了？”
红衣女：“都说了亡魂和活尸的行为是没有逻辑的。”
宁语却忽然眼前一亮：
“不对，是有的，有逻辑的，他一定是听到了我刚才的话，知道我们都是密大学院的后辈，所以才只身前往妖鬼王的巢穴帮我们取回螺旋剑，即便已经身亡，伟大无私的意志依旧在支撑着他的**做正确的事情，我不允许你们再用言语侮辱那位前辈！”
“还有，天监纪元是存在的！
那个时代诞生了无数可歌可泣的英雄人物，是他们守护了这片天地，且自愿消失在岁月长河中…”
宁语言辞凿凿。
红衣女与坤对视了一眼，各自都无语地摇了摇头，懒得再搭理宁语这些魔怔言辞。
在他们俩看来，被遗忘的活尸不可能保留有自主意识，即便有，那也与它生前没有任何关系，只不过是残尸上诞生的一种新的异端生命体。
如今己方想要离开这里，唯一可行的方法依然是把那活尸逮回来，丢进篝火…
来自妖鬼巢穴的一声闷哼打断了众人的思绪，令他们神经瞬间紧绷了起来。
而就在众人思量着是不是应该立马转头跑回辛之墓群深处躲起来的时候，一道熟悉的身影从巢穴深处被甩飞了出来。
正是那活尸。
活尸坠落在地，砸出了一块不大不小的凹坑，久久没有动静。
坤小心翼翼地探出头朝远方的凹坑张望：
“我就说一个活尸怎么可能打赢妖鬼王……所以它死了吗？”
content_en:
"Why did he go to the Demon King's lair?"
Ning Yu, Kun, and the woman in red followed Hui Wu's route in the dark and came to the edge of Xin's Tombs, and they did not dare to go any further.
因为再往前他们就离开了墓群的蕈类荧光的掩护，游离在这片地底世界的妖鬼子嗣会很快发现他们的踪迹。
A group of human cats were in the low-lying area on the edge of the tombs, secretly observing the strangely dressed deceased.
Woman in red: "There are only dead people and demons in Xin's Tombs. It's either a dead soul or a living corpse. There's no need to delve into the logic of the dead's behavior."
Ning Yu: "I have seen living corpses and dead souls. Those creatures have no independent consciousness and behavioral logic, but he is different."
The woman in red gave Ning Yu a cold look.
If it hadn't been for the mage who was studying death and suddenly fell ill with Mary's disease, they would have thrown the deceased's body into the bonfire altar, activated the teleportation array, and run away.
Ning Yu stared back in dissatisfaction: "I'm not lying. He is really a teacher at the University of Michigan. The monument was erected in the 23rd year of the Tianjian Era. That's what the inscription says."
坤：“天监纪元存不存在都不好说…”
The woman in red also said to Ning Yu angrily: "Then go over and persuade her to let her cremate herself and let us leave here."
Ning Yu: "Just go!"
She was about to stand up while holding the dictionary.
Before the burly man could stop her, the woman in red grabbed her shoulders and pushed her back, lowering her voice and yelling: "I don't want my life!"
When a group of people hesitate to move forward.
Hui Wu entered the demon king's lair alone.
Kun: "It just walked in?"
Woman in red: "We have said that the behavior of dead souls and living corpses is illogical."
Ning Yu's eyes suddenly lit up:
"No, there is. It's logical. He must have heard what I just said and knew that we are all juniors of the University of Michigan. That's why he went to the Demon King's lair alone to help us retrieve the Spiral Sword. Even though he is dead, his great and selfless will is still supporting his body to do the right thing. I will not allow you to insult that senior with words anymore!"
“Also, the Heavenly Supervisor Era exists!
Countless heroic figures were born in that era. They protected this world and voluntarily disappeared in the long river of time..."
Ning's words are precise.
The woman in red and Kun looked at each other and shook their heads speechlessly, too lazy to pay attention to Ning Yu's crazy words.
In their opinion, it is impossible for the forgotten living corpse to retain its independent consciousness. Even if it does, it has nothing to do with it during its lifetime. It is just a new heretical life form born on the corpse.
Now that we want to leave here, the only feasible way is to catch the living corpse and throw it into the bonfire...
"Ho!
! "
A muffled groan from the demon's lair interrupted everyone's thoughts, making their nerves tense instantly.
And just when everyone was thinking about whether they should immediately turn around and run back to the depths of Xin's Tombs to hide, a familiar figure was thrown away from the depths of the lair.
It was the living corpse.
Bang——
The living corpse fell to the ground, making a small dent, and there was no movement for a long time.
Kun cautiously stuck his head out and looked at the pit in the distance:
"I'm just saying how can a living corpse defeat the Demon King...so is it dead?"
title_en: Chapter 3 It’s Not Dead Chapter 4 An Unimagined Plot Line
